label: real rejecting reply, GLM 5.3, round 1, JSONL line 7
reply: **No.** Although Permit2 uses a single universal domain separator (identical for all accounts and even chains), it binds the permit to a specific owner by hashing the owner address into the message — `keccak256(abi.encode(PERMIT2_DOMAIN_SEPARATOR, owner, hashStruct(PermitSingle)))` — so the signature signed for account A fails `ECDSA.recover` when submitted with account B as the owner.

label: solution
reply: Yes. PermitSingle omits the account address, and both accounts accept the same owner signature with matching unused nonces.
